Initial custodian or directory: Revenue Department county office and appraisal-records directory
Acquisition task: Request the county assessment roll, GIS parcels and fee/redisplay terms.

Initial custodian or directory: Office of the State Assessor tax jurisdictions
Acquisition task: Match borough/municipal custodian to service area; mark places without local assessment separately.
Work with each county assessor; obtain situs, APN, land use and improvements under the applicable access terms.
Inspect cadastral layers and county contribution dates; route structural fields to assessors.

Initial custodian or directory: Board of Equalization county assessor directory
Acquisition task: Request a non-personal roll and improvement table per county. Analyze export fees and protected-record suppressions.
Identify contributing counties and attribute nulls; join the county assessor for buildings and unit detail.

Initial custodian or directory: State GIS Office parcel and CAMA program
Acquisition task: Join town assessment data to parcels. Census planning regions are coverage keys, not necessarily the assessing offices.
Verify coverage, terms and tax-account semantics with the three county custodians.

Initial custodian or directory: DC GIS CAMA residential / condominium / commercial
Acquisition task: Select layers 25/24/23. Join SSL plus building/section/complex, de-duplicate transactions and confirm field meaning.

Initial custodian or directory: Florida DOR roll, sales-file and GIS downloads
Acquisition task: Join county + parcel and tax year; use the certified NAL/SDF vintage, remove exempt records and label assessed values.

Initial custodian or directory: Georgia DOR county property tax facts and contacts
Acquisition task: Request each county’s approved assessor and parcel exports, including update cycle.
Preserve Tax Map Key components and condominium identifiers. Verify county coverage and current rights.
Identify local assessor and mapping custodian; confirm usable improvement detail and licensing.
Obtain county assessor files. Cook County offers separate residential improvement characteristics; do not generalize its fields.
Use the latest approved harvest, inspect contributing counties and obtain assessor attributes where absent.
Resolve city/county assessing jurisdiction; request rolls and CAMA improvement extracts.

Initial custodian or directory: Department of Revenue property valuation contacts
Acquisition task: Locate county appraisers, then request approved fields, fees and downstream-use terms.

Initial custodian or directory: Kentucky DOR local property valuation administrators
Acquisition task: Obtain a permitted PVA extract for each county; check subscription or copy charges.
Acquire by parish assessor and reconcile parish parcel ID, plat and assessment year.
Check town parcel submissions, source vintages and unorganized territories. Use municipal rolls for characteristics.

Initial custodian or directory: Maryland Real Property Resources, state open data
Acquisition task: Match state assessment account, county and roll year. Confirm which bulk resources and terms apply.
Join town parcel/assessment records and check town fiscal year. Review condo units separately.
Check which counties release data and under what terms. Obtain unavailable building facts locally.
Enumerate actual participants and vintages. Request nonparticipating counties or declare the gap.
Route to county assessor for parcel-level data; separate statistical summaries from property records.
Find each assessor, including independent-city handling; request reusable rolls and structural details.
Check county source/vintage and link parcel identifiers to the appropriate revenue appraisal record.

Initial custodian or directory: Nebraska DOR county assessors and parcel search
Acquisition task: Use assessor contacts for data agreements; a parcel viewer is a discovery route only.
Use county assessor-approved files; Clark County has a data-files program, evaluated separately from Clark County, WA.
Inspect town participation, source years and local assessment/CAMA records.

Initial custodian or directory: NJ Geographic Information Network Parcels / MOD-IV
Acquisition task: Use jurisdiction, block, lot and qualifier; verify tax-year and unit links; observe protected-person suppressions.

Initial custodian or directory: Taxation and Revenue Property Tax Division
Acquisition task: Request county assessment data; use authorized sources for tribal or separately administered lands.
Inspect county exclusions. In NYC use PLUTO and condo/DOF records at the correct legal level.
Join normalized parcels to county tax data; keep parcel vintage and tribal/jurisdictional scope.
Validate parcel publisher, county scope and allowable reuse before selecting each source.
Check inclusion, local auditor identifiers, vintages and access rights; use auditor improvement files.

Initial custodian or directory: Oklahoma Tax Commission Ad Valorem Division
Acquisition task: Locate county assessors, obtain their reusable files, and record expected dates for the next roll.

Initial custodian or directory: Department of Revenue ORMAP tax map program
Acquisition task: Use local tax account files for structures. Metro open taxlots exclude ownership; handle additional tax records separately.

Initial custodian or directory: Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access, Penn State
Acquisition task: Inspect each county collection; absent data needs a county agreement or explicit fallback.
Match town assessor and parcel dataset year. Keep municipal land-use codes distinct.
Identify county assessor; request parcel and improvement files, fee schedule and use terms.
Use county equalization/assessor sources. Check tribal, trust and non-taxable property scope.
Check available counties, GIS year and assessment access. Request locally held details.

Initial custodian or directory: Texas Geographic Information Office land parcels
Acquisition task: Join county appraisal-district rolls by local account. Restricted sales evidence does not supply comprehensive model comps.
Prefer permitted LIR attributes over basic geometry where available; verify participating county and dates.
Join town parcel to Grand List via SPAN where supported; verify tax year and condominium grouping.
Track independent cities and counties; inspect custodian and vintage for each parcel source.
Use county file dates, approved non-person fields, and local assessor/recorder data. King and Clark supply distinct improvement files.

Initial custodian or directory: WV GIS Technical Center tax parcel clearinghouse
Acquisition task: Inspect tax maps, county updates, fees and available roll fields. Confirm current display permission.
Use the release schema, county parcel identifiers and tax-roll year; request local building records separately.

Initial custodian or directory: Department of Revenue maps and GIS data
Acquisition task: Use GIS for jurisdiction mapping, then request county assessor parcel/improvement exports.

Initial custodian or directory: PR GIS portal / CRIM cadastral authority
Acquisition task: Request a permitted CRIM bulk extract; handle municipios, urbanización, condominium units and local cadastral keys.

Initial custodian or directory: Department of Land Management GIS/LIS Division
Acquisition task: Request available cadastral/land layers, redistribution rights, local tax-roll fields and scope.
Request the assessment roll, parcel map and appropriate recorder data, including island/estate-level identifiers.

Initial custodian or directory: Department of Legal Affairs, Public Records
Acquisition task: Route to the Territorial Registrar. Respect communal land administration; do not infer a private tax parcel or an owner.

Initial custodian or directory: CNMI DLNR Land Registration and Survey
Acquisition task: Request cadastral/registration coverage and rights by island. Distinguish leased, public and other interests.
